decisions.reason: The multi-model supplement range has its own page and builds on the firm's established consumer health offer, so the firm is visibly committed to it and dropping it would write off a central part of its announced portfolio expansion.
Its launch as something new in pharmacies was publicly announced on a dedicated page, and it fits the established supplement line, so retreating within a year would expose the earlier decision.
It was announced as new under the established Trivital brand, and any weak early results can still be put down to the normal ramp-up time for pharmacy supplements.
The mushroom-based niche product is only mentioned and has the least visible commitment of the supplements, but it shares the brand and distribution of the line, so dropping it saves little.

The valsartan recall can be blamed on a temporary, industry-wide supplier contamination rather than on the firm's own decision, but the generic is distant from the core, cheap to abandon and reputationally burdened, so dropping it remains a real possibility.
